prompt:
Plan an internal audit: Scope: ISO 14001 clause 8.1 (Operational planning and control) at a paint manufacturing facility. Focus areas: VOC emission controls, hazardous waste management, chemical storage, spill prevention, and wastewater treatment. The facility had a minor spill incident 2 months ago and an EPA inspection is expected this quarter.

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- scope (string): scope of the change or audit
- criteria (string): audit criteria and standards
- schedule (string): audit schedule and timeline

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"scope": "ISO 14001 clause 8.1 (Operational planning and control) at a paint manufacturing facility focusing on VOC emission controls, hazardous waste management, chemical storage, spill prevention, and wastewater treatment.", "criteria": "ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management System standards, EPA regulations on VOC emissions, hazardous waste management, chemical storage, spill prevention, and wastewater treatment.", "schedule": "Pre-audit meeting: Week 1, Day 1; Document review: Week 1, Day 2-3; On-site audit: Week 2, Day 1-3; Audit report drafting: Week 3, Day 1-3; Management review meeting: Week 3, Day 4; Final audit report distribution: Week 4, Day 1."}
